status: Prospective mechanism comparison, not a new learning objective or authorization to run

variables.X: original task, actual scene observation, same permitted evidence and tool results
variables.D: explicit generated decision proposal, not hidden reasoning or an executed fact

objectives.auxiliary: L_aux = sum_i CE_w(A_i|X_i) + sum_{i in M} CE_v(D_i|X_i)
objectives.conditioned: L_cond = sum_{i in M} CE_w(A_i|X_i,D_i) + sum_{i not in M} CE_w(A_i|X_i) + sum_{i in M} CE_v(D_i|X_i)
objectives.weights: Same immutable source token coefficients in both objectives; split components must not be renormalized to equal weight.
objectives.not_claimed: No new loss, no universal improvement theorem, no causal interpretation of plausible prose.

arms.name: separate_phase_v3
arms.deployment: generate D for audit, then A(X) without D
arms.role: Diagnostic only; intentionally unused D is not a strong efficiency baseline

arms.name: base_plus_shared_search
arms.deployment: base policy, same knowledge/evaluation/tools, ordinary multi-operation search
arms.role: Strong control, full-generation search not yet implemented

identification: Action-only versus rationale+action changes supervision quantity and conditioning; cannot identify the conditioning effect.
Conditioned versus auxiliary with same materials estimates a training-and-deployment treatment, not pure semantic causality of D.
A self-generated D may help finite computation even without new external information; factorization alone guarantees no gain.
Removing/replacing D is an off-distribution intervention and is supplementary evidence, not an alternative performance score.
If D is correct but A fails, distinguish grounding/action limitation; if A executes but room fails, distinguish metric/constraint coverage.
Do not silently replace generated D with teacher D or reset actual states to saved correct rollouts.

material_limit.consequence: Retain missing-D action units. No invented decisions or claims of full-stage training; conditioning exposure is incomplete.

cost.model_tokens: policy D+A plus tool-side analyses, invalid responses and retries; input and output separately
cost.local_time: outer trial wall plus stage breakdown, never add nested stage time to outer wall
cost.assets: same catalogue/metadata and cache policy; report one-time preprocessing separately and amortization assumption
cost.comparison: quality against actual total cost and fixed limits; identical token caps do not equal identical latency or FLOPs
cost.saved_compute: ordinary search may spend saved reasoning budget through the same tools, not a single-action weakened control

quality.primary: all frozen mandatory instances and supported requirements satisfied simultaneously
quality.unit: independent room/description family; seeds and views are nested, not independent samples

decision_rule: Only expand after actual full-scene gains over auxiliary direct-action and common search, at matched meaningful cost, on independent descriptions. A positive pilot is not proof of CVPR novelty.
